terms.title: Terms of use
terms.ask: Have you read and do you accept them?
terms.declined: Without accepting, only the read-only modes work: --diagnostico, --simular and --reparar.
terms.interactive: Open NOVAIS boost once interactively to accept the terms of use.
terms.1: NOVAIS boost changes Windows, driver and game settings to gain performance.
terms.2: Before any change it creates a restore point and a backup, and everything can be undone in Revert / Backups.
terms.3: It never turns off Secure Boot, TPM, driver signing or Defender, never injects anything into games and never overclocks.
terms.4: Results vary from PC to PC. Use Prove tweaks to measure the effect on yours.
terms.5: You use the program at your own risk; review the simulation before confirming each change.
terms.6: Nothing is sent to the internet unless you turn it on (error reports and the anonymous database are optional).
